instruction: In packages/shared/src/agent-todo.ts, when a model outputs checklist items with a leading ordinal such as "- [x] 1. Schema" or "- [ ] 2) add subcommand", parseAgentTodoText keeps "1. " or "2) " in the item text (while quantities like "- [ ] 3 items" without punctuation after the digit should stay intact). Strip leading numbered ordinals followed by ., ), or 、 and whitespace from parsed checklist items.
